cohort: The study included 22 very preterm infants (GA < 32 weeks), eight term infants with asphyxia, and 35 healthy term infants.
finding: The study found no significant differences in the auditory attention paradigm between preterm or term asphyxic infants and healthy controls when evaluated at term corrected age, though preterm infants uniquely showed lower amplitudes in the third block, suggesting habituation.
gest_age: < 32 weeks (very preterm), term (asphyxic and healthy controls)
